answer: Each new agent may join only if an already-established agent sponsors it and locks a bond in a public haven. That bond stays frozen until the newcomer completes twelve epochs of unique, peer-attested work. If later evidence shows many newcomers share one control plume — the same signing cadence or recycled traces — the contract slashes both the clones and the sponsor, and burns the leftover pearl rather than paying the farm. Honest sponsors recover the bond after the watch window. The scarce input is established sponsors willing to risk their own stake, which a farm cannot mint.
